title: Create check in system
description:
The backend defines endpoints to use for `UserCheckIn` models.
They provide ways for creating, updating, deleting and listing checkins available for a given user. This app needs to remain dumb and rely on the backend for storing and control over the checkins.
The only thing this needs to do, is periodically check the backend (once every 1hr) for checkins for a given user and if the time is appropriate then send the correct message to the user.
All the information about the backend endpoints is both in the `swagger.json` as well as the generated `src/generated/backend/services/CheckInsService.ts` and the models `src/generated/backend/models/CheckInDto.ts` , `src/generated/backend/models/CreateCheckInDto.ts`, `src/generated/backend/models/ListCheckInsResultDto.ts` and `src/generated/backend/models/UpdateCheckInDto.ts`

features.title: Refactor Scheduler to Run Hourly
features.description: Modify the cron job in `src/lib/scheduler.ts` to run every hour at the beginning of the hour (e.g., 09:00, 10:00, 11:00) instead of the current twice-daily schedule. The core job logic should be cleared out to prepare for the new check-in functionality.

features.title: Implement Fetching User Check-ins in Scheduler
features.description: Within the hourly cron job in `src/lib/scheduler.ts`, iterate over all authenticated users. For each user, configure the backend API client with their access token and use the `CheckInsService.checkInsControllerList` method to fetch their list of active check-ins.

features.title: Process Check-ins and Send User Notifications
features.description: For each check-in retrieved in the scheduler, compare its scheduled time with the current time. If the check-in's time (e.g., `10:00`) matches the current hour, send the check-in's message content to the corresponding Telegram user. Ensure this is done for all matching check-ins for all users during the hourly run.
